policy: Background removal through reviewed masks, white outline, downsize and compression only. No cake recolouring, retouching or synthesized detail.
review: Masks require visual review; source-clipped details remain clipped. Full prepared photos remain available in the viewer.

photos.alt: An orange cake with white floral piping, green trim and a tall peacock feather decoration.
photos.source_limitation: Patterned seating remains behind the feather; its upper edge was already clipped in the source. Original photo-frame cuts are now rounded inward; no missing detail is reconstructed.

photos.alt: A white-frosted round cake decorated with burgundy bows, pink pearl shapes and piped loops.
photos.source_limitation: Original frosting texture, lighting and table setting are retained.

photos.alt: A round cake with white piped swirls, red cherries, colourful sprinkles and textured sides.
photos.source_limitation: Some top cherries were already clipped in the source; a small background object remains. Original photo-frame cuts are now rounded inward; no missing detail is reconstructed.

photos.alt: A doll cake with a pink-and-white piped dress and small gold-coloured decorations.
photos.source_limitation: The dress base was already clipped in the source; some household background remains. Original photo-frame cuts are now rounded inward; no missing detail is reconstructed.

photos.alt: A white-frosted celebration cake with butterfly decorations, red cherries and a piped message.
photos.source_limitation: Existing lettering is unchanged; no flavour is inferred from its appearance.

photos.alt: A white cake with rainbow-coloured piped arcs, sprinkles and a large multicoloured butterfly topper.
photos.source_limitation: Original lighting and table setting retained; no flavour or ingredient is inferred.

photos.alt: A purple drip cake with pale swirls, colourful butterflies, sprinkles and a Happy Birthday topper.
photos.source_limitation: The lower cake board and a small part of the base were already clipped in the export image; no missing detail is reconstructed. Original photo-frame cuts are now rounded inward; no missing detail is reconstructed.

photos.alt: A round white cake with golden-coloured drips, white piped swirls, sprinkles and amber-coloured pieces on top.
photos.source_limitation: The visual name describes colour and decoration, not a confirmed flavour.

photos.alt: A white-frosted round cake covered in dark curls, with red cherries on tall white piped swirls.
photos.source_limitation: Original kitchen background and lighting remain in the full photo; the design name does not promise a flavour.

photos.alt: A golden-coloured drip cake with pink-and-white piped swirls, silver-coloured pearls and amber-coloured decorations.
photos.source_limitation: The visual name describes the decoration, not a confirmed flavour or edible-decoration guarantee.

photos.alt: A dark-topped drip cake with pale piped swirls, silver-coloured pearls and a pink rose with green leaves.
photos.source_limitation: The lower edge of the cake and board was already clipped in the source; no missing detail is reconstructed. Original photo-frame cuts are now rounded inward; no missing detail is reconstructed.

photos.alt: A white cake with yellow drips, lavender-and-white piped swirls, metallic-coloured pearls and a celebration message.
photos.source_limitation: A few swirls at the upper image edge were already clipped in the source; they are not reconstructed. Original photo-frame cuts are now rounded inward; no missing detail is reconstructed.

photos.alt: Two owner-identified tea cakes, one round and one heart-shaped, photographed together.
photos.source_limitation: Full source framing and RGB are retained. Original newspaper/background must be excluded only in a separate alpha derivative. No flavour is inferred. Generated cutouts require visual review.

photos.alt: An owner-identified assortment of chocolates in heart, flower, cupcake and small figure shapes.
photos.source_limitation: Some pieces meet or extend beyond the source edges; never reconstruct them. Full source RGB is retained. Generated cutouts require visual review, particularly removal of the tray and paper between pieces. Original photo-frame cuts are now rounded inward; no missing detail is reconstructed.

photos.alt: A white celebration cake with pink, blue and white piping, gold-coloured hearts and its original Happy Anniversary topper.
photos.source_limitation: Keep the original topper, initials, colours and already-clipped edges. No lettering or missing detail is rewritten. Generated cutouts require visual review. Original photo-frame cuts are now rounded inward; no missing detail is reconstructed.
